title: Gitmal: a static site generator for your Git repositories  #github
description:
Imagine browsing a Git repo… without GitHub, without a server, and without any backend. That’s Gitmal — a static site generator for your Git repositories. Gitmal takes your entire repo — files, folders, commits, diffs, markdown — and turns it into a clean, blazing-fast static website. 

https://github.com/antonmedv/gitmal

#github #opensource
